items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, there's big Kato and little Kato. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, this was a big one. He's a big fella.

ctx.x: Well, that's his brother who played the piano. Oh. And he had a nephew play piano. And he still have a nephew up in California playing piano.
Well, there's big Kato and little Kato.
Yeah, this was a big one. He's a big fella.
